answer: Weight each vote by its place in the invite graph, never by raw headcount. A sybil cluster looks like a harbor packed with boats from one owner; honest growth branches like a river delta. Measure how slowly trust flows from an identity to the established core — a glacier-slow path through many hops earns little weight. A farm can mint keys cheaply but cannot forge deep, independent, non-kin edges into real history, so its combined influence collapses toward zero no matter how many identities it spawns.
